rationale: The obligation asks whether FY2025 enforceable effluent limitations and monitoring requirements for all three listed facilities are operative in permit Parts rather than as independent limits in fact sheets or statements of basis. The packet partially supports a Parts-as-operative-source reading for at least one permit: the Farmington final-permit cover page locates effluent limitations and monitoring requirements in Parts I–IV, and the fact-sheet/statement-of-basis excerpts are framed as draft supporting documents. However, the packet does not establish the proposition across the full facility set: only NM0020583 is explicitly identified, while NM0028762 and NM0000116 are not linked to any excerpted permit or supporting document. No Part text, monitoring table, or effluent-limit excerpt is included to show what is enforceable for FY2025, and the draft fact-sheet/statement-of-basis spans do not establish that those documents cannot themselves contain operative numeric limits. Because neither ACCEPT (operative Parts vs rationale-only fact sheets/SOB for all facilities in FY2025) nor REJECT (limits are not in Parts or fact sheets/SOB are independent operative sources) is grounded by the packet, UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
